$comment: Game UI genre profiles for scripts/game-refs.mjs and scripts/game-prompt.mjs. Genre ids follow the 21 playbooks of game-launch-strategist (references/playbooks.md) plus a few extra. refs = titles whose UI is worth reverse-engineering (resolved to Steam ids at runtime, never trusted blindly: always look at the screenshots). slots = parts the game renders, not the UI (see references/game-ui.md, Game slots).

genres.label: Roguelite / deckbuilder / survivors-like
hud: health and shield as chunky segmented bars, bottom-left or top-left
currency and run resources top-right with icon + number
relics / boons as an icon tray with hover tooltips
boss bar top-center only during boss fights
active ability cooldowns as radial wipes near the character or bottom-center
layout: reward picks are 2-4 large cards in a row, the choice is the whole screen
the run map is a vertical node graph with path lines and node icons, the current node pulses once
tooltips are rich: name, rarity, numbers with keyword highlights, flavor line
genres.type: a characterful display face for titles and card names (serif, blackletter or hand-cut), a dense condensed sans for numbers and keywords
genres.motion: snappy 80-160ms on cards, a juicy pop on pick (scale 1 → 1.06 → 1), numbers count up, no slow fades
signature: keyword highlighting inside descriptions (color + icon per status)
rarity told by frame material, not only color
synergy hints that light up related items
a run summary with build icons and damage breakdown

slots.where: character / boon giver portrait on reward screens

genres.label: Cozy / life sim / farming / crafting
hud: clock, day and weather in one corner as an illustrated badge
energy as a soft vertical bar or food icon
hotbar of 10-12 slots bottom-center with the selected slot lifted
money with a coin icon near the clock
layout: inventory as a bag or chest grid with a character paper doll on the left
crafting shows recipe → ingredients with have/need counts
relationships as portrait cards with hearts
genres.type: a warm rounded or hand-lettered display face, a friendly humanist body face; numbers in the display face
genres.motion: soft but quick (140-220ms), gentle squash on buttons, leaves or sparkles only on rewards
signature: diegetic objects: the journal is a notebook, the shop is a counter
item icons with outline + soft shadow on a paper slot
seasonal palette swaps
avoid: pastel SaaS cards with drop shadows

slots.where: character paper doll in inventory and wardrobe

genres.label: Horror (psychological, survival, retro / PSX, analog)
hud: as little HUD as possible: health shown diegetically or only when hurt
ammo near the weapon when aiming
interaction prompts small and low-contrast until close
no permanent minimap
layout: inventory as a grid case or a physical bag with item inspection in 3D
documents as paper on a desk with a readable transcription panel
map as a hand-drawn or blueprint sheet with explored rooms filled
genres.type: an institutional or typewriter face for documents, a thin distressed or stencil display face for titles; never a playful face
genres.motion: slow fades are allowed here (300-600ms) but input response stays instant; flicker and glitch only as events
signature: item inspection with rotate and zoom
UI that degrades with sanity or damage
diegetic save points (typewriter, tape recorder)
silence: empty space is part of the design

slots.where: behind every screen; the main menu is often a live scene

genres.label: Boomer shooter / retro FPS / action shooter
hud: health and armor bottom-left as big numbers with a bar
ammo bottom-right with the weapon icon and reserve
crosshair that reacts to hits (hit marker, kill confirm)
style or combo meter on the side if the game scores movement
layout: weapon wheel radial at screen center with the selected sector lifted
results as a ranked score sheet: time, kills, secrets, rank letter
loadout shows the weapon model large with stat bars
materials: pixel or low-res bitmap UI for retro
chrome and blood for hellish themes
genres.type: a heavy condensed or stencil display face, huge numerals; monospace for data readouts
genres.motion: instant (0-80ms) for HUD changes, a short punch on damage and kills; screen shake belongs to the game, not the UI
signature: numbers that are art (big, outlined, slanted)
hit feedback layered on the crosshair
rank letters with their own animation
avoid: thin text over bright scenes without backing

slots.where: behind the HUD and the pause menu
weapon model in loadout and codex
first-person hands/weapon is the game, not the UI

genres.label: Strategy / 4X / city builder / tower defense / automation
hud: resources top bar with icon + amount + rate (+12/min)
build categories bottom bar with hotkeys
selection panel bottom-left with portrait and actions
minimap bottom-right
alerts as stacked icons on the side
layout: dense information is normal: tables, tabs, filters
tooltips nest (hover a term → tooltip in tooltip)
event popups as illustrated cards with 2-3 choices and outcomes
genres.type: a serious serif or slab for titles, a legible small-size sans or condensed for data; tabular numerals
genres.motion: fast and quiet (100-160ms); numbers tick; nothing blocks the map
signature: resource rates and trends next to amounts
illustrated event cards
a ledger or overview screen that reads like a real document
avoid: icons without labels in dense panels

slots.where: unit or building portrait in the selection panel

genres.label: Puzzle / arcade
hud: move counter or timer, one corner, large
undo / reset buttons always visible with key glyphs
hint button that costs or waits
layout: level select as a world map, a grid of tiles or a book
level complete shows stars or score and the next level in one press
genres.type: a distinctive geometric or rounded display face; numbers very large
genres.motion: crisp and satisfying (100-200ms), the solve moment gets the one big animation
signature: the level select is a place, not a list
solve feedback that feels physical
avoid: SaaS card grid as level select

genres.label: Narrative / visual novel / walking sim / dating sim
hud: no HUD in exploration; the dialogue box is the HUD
auto / skip / log / save controls small at the dialogue box edge
layout: dialogue: speaker name plate + portrait + box in the lower third, or a side column (Disco Elysium) for long text
choices as a vertical list with skill checks or tone tags
journal as a real object (notebook, case board)
genres.type: pair a literary serif for text with a display face for names; generous line height, 60-75 characters per line
genres.motion: text reveal at reading speed with instant complete on press, portraits shift expression without sliding around
signature: the speaker frame tells who speaks (color, shape, position)
skill checks with odds shown
a case board or journal that grows

slots.where: speaker portraits (2D sprites or 3D character renders)

genres.label: Platformer / metroidvania / action-adventure
refs: Ori and the Will of the Wisps
Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown
hud: health as masks, hearts or segments top-left
currency top-left under health
ability or charm slots minimal
no clutter at the bottom (the player looks at the floor)
layout: map is a full-screen illustrated sheet with pins, legend and fog
inventory as a charm board or relic grid with a description panel
genres.type: an ornate or engraved display face, a readable serif or humanist body
genres.motion: short and elegant (120-200ms); map pins drop in, never slide whole panels
signature: hand-drawn map with stamp icons
ornamental frames that belong to the world

slots.where: full-screen map is UI-drawn from explored rooms

genres.label: Survival craft / open world / co-op
hud: vitals (health, hunger, thirst, stamina) as small icon bars bottom-left or only when low
compass strip top-center with markers
quickbar bottom-center
status effects as icons near the vitals
layout: inventory as a grid with item sizes (Tarkov) or weight-based list; containers side by side for looting
crafting as recipe list → requirements → craft queue
map as a paper or PDA map with player markers and notes
genres.type: a condensed industrial or stencil face for titles, a utilitarian sans or mono for item data; Cyrillic or local scripts if the setting needs it
genres.motion: functional and fast (80-150ms); drag and drop with clear drop targets
signature: item grids where size and condition are visible
diegetic devices (PDA, radio, map case)
serial numbers, stamps and wear as ornament
a death screen that tells the story of the run
avoid: fantasy ornament in a realistic setting

slots.where: behind the HUD; often the main menu is a live scene
character paper doll in the character and inventory screens

genres.label: RPG / JRPG / tactical
hud: party portraits with HP / MP bars on one side
turn order bar top
command menu near the active character
damage numbers in the world, not in a panel
layout: character sheet with a full-body render, stats with comparisons (green up / red down) and equipment slots around it
skill tree as a constellation or grid with locked fog
quest log as tabs: main, side, completed with objectives checked
genres.type: a strong display face with personality, a readable body; small caps for stat labels
genres.motion: stylish transitions are welcome here (Persona-style wipes 200-350ms) but menus answer instantly
signature: menus with a strong graphic idea (angles, wipes, a signature shape)
stat comparison on hover
character renders as part of the composition

slots.where: full-body character on the equipment / character screen

genres.label: Idle / incremental / light management
refs: Idle Champions of the Forgotten Realms
hud: the main number huge, with the rate per second
upgrade list with cost, owned and next effect
prestige progress always visible
layout: one dense main screen with columns; scrolling lists are fine
big numbers formatted (1.2M, 3.4e12) with tabular numerals
genres.type: a strong numeric face; numbers are the hero
genres.motion: number tick-ups and small pops on purchase; no blocking animations
signature: the growth curve is felt: rates, milestones, unlock teasers

genres.label: Competitive multiplayer / party / hero shooter / battle royale
hud: health and abilities bottom-center or bottom-left with cooldowns
kill feed top-right
scoreboard / round timer top-center
minimap top-left (BR / MOBA)
pings and markers in the world
layout: lobby: the squad as 3D characters center stage, play button bottom-right
hero select: roster grid + big character render + abilities
scoreboard dense table with your row highlighted
materials: clean esports graphic language with one hot accent
genres.type: a sharp condensed display face, a very legible sans for numbers at small sizes
genres.motion: fast (80-160ms); match results can be cinematic, the HUD never animates for show
signature: the lobby is a stage for the characters
ability icons with distinct silhouettes
readability at 1080p in motion

slots.where: squad characters in the lobby and hero select (live 3D)
skins and weapon preview in store / loadout

genres.label: Racing and sports (arcade, kart, football, basketball, niche)
hud: position, lap and time top corners (racing)
speed and gear bottom-right
score bug top-left like a TV broadcast (sports)
minimap of the track
layout: broadcast graphics: lower thirds, score bugs, lineup cards
garage with the car large and stat bars
team select with crests and kits
genres.type: a sporty italic or condensed display face, tabular numerals for times
genres.motion: broadcast-style wipes and slides (150-250ms), timers never stop updating
signature: the UI borrows from real broadcasts
lineups and stats that feel like real sport data

slots.where: car in the garage or player in team select

genres.label: Driving, flight and vehicle simulators
hud: instruments are diegetic in the cockpit; the HUD shows only what the cockpit cannot
navigation and job info in a compact panel
assists and damage status as small icons
layout: career as a job board with routes and pay
settings deep and well grouped (controls, assists, graphics)
genres.type: a technical sans, real instrument numerals
genres.motion: realistic and calm; no game-show effects
signature: UI that looks like real equipment
maps with real-world feel

genres.label: Rhythm game
hud: combo and accuracy near the play area, score in a corner
judgment text (Perfect / Great) at the hit line
layout: song select as a big carousel with album art, difficulty and best score
results with grade letter and accuracy breakdown
genres.type: a bold display face with rhythm; grades are typographic art
genres.motion: everything pulses on the beat (BPM-synced), otherwise snappy
signature: UI that moves on the beat
album-art driven song select

genres.label: Fighting game
refs: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves
hud: two health bars mirrored at the top with portraits and round timer in the center
super meters at the bottom corners
combo counter on the attacker's side
layout: character select: roster grid center, two big renders left and right
versus screen: split diagonal with names
training: frame data overlay
genres.type: an aggressive display face; names huge and italic
genres.motion: punchy (60-120ms), screen-wide wipes for versus
signature: mirrored symmetry
character select as a stage for both players

slots.where: full-body fighters in character select and versus screen

genres.label: Co-op horror
hud: minimal: stamina, held item, an inventory strip
scanner or terminal as diegetic UI
teammate status small and only when relevant
layout: lobby is a physical space (truck, ship, van)
terminal UI in green or amber monospace for orders and logs
genres.type: monospace and corporate sans; jokes in the copy
genres.motion: instant; glitches as events
signature: diegetic terminals and devices
corporate humor in the copy
avoid: polished AAA menus that kill the tone

slots.where: camera feeds or player body cams

genres.label: Soulslike / action RPG
hud: health, focus and stamina as thin long bars top-left
quick items and spells bottom-left in a cross (d-pad layout)
souls / currency bottom-right
boss name and bar bottom-center
layout: equipment as slot columns with a stat panel that compares on hover
item descriptions with lore paragraphs and an item render
level up as a stat list with before → after
materials: dark stone, iron and gold leaf
thin hairline frames with ornament corners
genres.type: a classical serif (Trajan-like or a high-contrast old style), small caps for stats
genres.motion: restrained and slow-feeling (200-300ms fades) but responsive; the death text is the event
signature: thin ornamental frames
lore as a first-class element
the d-pad cross of quick slots

slots.where: behind the HUD and menus (the game keeps running)

genres.label: Management / tycoon / business sim
hud: money and rating top bar
build toolbar bottom
notifications stacked on a side
time controls (pause, 1x, 2x, 3x)
layout: finances as charts and tables that read like a real report
info panels for selected objects with tabs
genres.type: a friendly but structured sans, tabular numerals
genres.motion: quick (120-180ms); money ticks
signature: data that is fun to read
charts in the game's palette
avoid: SaaS dashboard look without the theme

slots.where: staff or animal portraits in info panels

genres.label: Sandbox / creative / physics
hud: hotbar bottom-center
tool or mode indicator
crosshair or cursor info
layout: build palette as a categorized grid with search
world select with thumbnails
genres.type: a blocky or friendly display face
genres.motion: snappy
signature: thumbnails generated from the player's own worlds

slots.where: block / part thumbnails and world thumbnails

genres.label: Graphic adventure / point and click / escape room
refs: The Case of the Golden Idol
The Rise of the Golden Idol
hud: cursor that changes per action
inventory bar that hides until needed
layout: deduction screen as fill-in-the-blank sentences or a case board
inventory as a bar or a bag
genres.type: a hand-drawn or period display face
genres.motion: calm and clear
signature: deduction mechanics as UI
the notebook remembers everything

genres.label: Card game / CCG / auto battler
hud: hand at the bottom fanned
mana or energy near the hand
hero portraits with health top and bottom
layout: collection grid with filters and counts
deck builder: collection left, deck list right with curve chart
genres.type: a strong display face for card names, compact body for rules text with keyword bolding
genres.motion: tactile card motion (hover lift, drag, play slam), pack opening is the one cinematic moment
signature: card frames with layered materials
foil variants
the board as a physical place

genres.label: Open world action / third-person action-adventure
hud: minimap bottom-left with health and armor around it
wanted level or alert state near the minimap
mission objective top-right short
weapon and ammo top-right
layout: full-screen map with legend, waypoints and filters
in-game phone as a real device
weapon wheel radial
materials: the game's own brands and city signage
genres.type: a display face from the game's world (brands, posters), clean sans for HUD
genres.motion: fast HUD, cinematic pause menu over the frozen world
signature: fake brands and in-world products in the UI
the phone as a whole UI system
avoid: generic menus without the world's flavor

slots.where: character in the character / wardrobe screen
